;Business and economy
*The [[La Línea (Road Pass)|La Línea]] highway tunnel is opened in [[Colombia]] after 14 years of construction and several delays. It is the longest road tunnel in [[South America]] at {{convert|8.65|km|miles}}. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-colombia-tunnel/colombia-opens-south-americas-longest-road-tunnel-idUSKBN25V2QT?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[2020 Atlantic hurricane season]]
**Two people in [[Vernon Parish, Louisiana|Vernon Parish]], [[Louisiana]] and five in [[Texas]] die during [[Hurricane Laura]], bringing the national death toll to 27. The two people in Louisiana died due to heat-related illness while removing debris. [https://www.klfy.com/local/heat-related-illness-brings-hurricane-laura-death-toll-to-22-in-la/ (KLFY)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/2-more-louisiana-die-heat-related-illness-after-hurricane-laura-n1239390 (NBC News)]
*[[2020 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Typhoon Maysak (2020)|Typhoon Maysak]]
***Rescuers find a second survivor from the presumed wreck of the [[Panama]]nian-flagged cargo ship ''[[Gulf Livestock 1]]''. A body was also pulled from the [[East China Sea]]. [https://www.news.com.au/world/asia/gulf-livestock-1-ship-missing-after-typhoon-maysak-in-japan/news-story/53de85336c34ab5646a318d7549ea602 (News.com.au)]
*[[2020 California wildfires]]
**The [[Big Basin Redwoods State Park]] is expected to close for a year due to damage caused by the [[CZU Lightning Complex fires|CZU Lightning Complex]] fires. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/travel/news/2020/09/04/big-basin-redwoods-state-park-expects-close-year-after-fires/5722378002/ (''USA Today'')] 
*The [[MT New Diamond|MT ''New Diamond'']] is towed out of sea off the coast of [[Sri Lanka]] amid major fears of a massive [[oil spill]] after the ship caught fire yesterday, killing one [[Filipinos|Filipino]] crewman. The [[Panama]]nian-registered ship carries about 270,000 tonnes of [[crude oil]]. The [[Government of the Maldives|government]] of the [[Maldives]] has expressed worry, with a presidential minister saying that the country needs to take all precautions to prevent oil from reaching its shores. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-54026289 (BBC News)]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in Réunion]], [[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on education]]
****[[Ministry of National Education (France)|Education minister]] [[Jean-Michel Blanquer]] announces that 22 [[Education in France|schools]] across [[metropolitan France]] and the [[Overseas department and region|overseas department]] of [[Réunion]] are closed again, only two days after the reopening of schools across the country, in response to rising cases and protests from parents and teachers' unions. [https://news.sky.com/story/coronavirus-france-closes-22-schools-due-to-covid-19-as-country-records-europes-highest-daily-infection-rate-12063287 (Sky News)]
****The [[Minister of Health (France)|health ministry]] reports 8,975 new cases in the last 24 hours, setting a new all-time record for France since the beginning of pandemic. [https://mobile.reuters.com/article/amp/idUSKBN25V2E5 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****Former [[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]] [[Silvio Berlusconi]] is hospitalized after testing positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-berlusconi-idUSKBN25V0WA (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****A study shows that the [[Gam-COVID-Vac]], [[Russia]]'s COVID-19 vaccine, has produced an antibody response with no serious side effects in a small trial. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-health-coronavirus-russia-vaccine/results-of-russias-covid-19-vaccine-produced-antibody-response-the-lancet-idUSKBN25V1I2 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Czech Republic]]
****The [[Czech Republic]] records 798 cases, marking the first time the country reported over 700 cases. [https://www.devdiscourse.com/article/health/1199407-czech-republic-sees-700-new-cases-for-1st-time (devdiscourse.com)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
***The death toll in [[Iran]] exceeds 22,000. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/09/04/Coronavirus-Iran-s-COVID-19-death-toll-exceeds-22-000-cases-spike-to-382-772 (Al Arabiya)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Zealand]]
***[[Prime Minister of New Zealand|Prime Minister]] [[Jacinda Ardern]] extends the Alert Level 2.5 [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns#New Zealand|restrictions]] on [[Auckland]] until at least September 14, while the rest of the country remains under Alert Level 2, after the [[Ministry of Health (New Zealand)|health ministry]] reported the first COVID-19 death in New Zealand since May. [https://www.straitstimes.com/asia/australianz/new-zealand-to-retain-coronavirus-measures-across-country-until-mid-september (Reuters via ''The Straits Times'')]
***Former [[Prime Minister of the Cook Islands]] [[Joe Williams (Cook Islands politician)|Joe Williams]], aged 85, becomes the second COVID-19 death in 24 hours. [https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&objectid=12362436 (''NZ Herald'')]
*A person is dead and sixteen others tested positive during a [[Legionella|legionella]] outbreak in [[Busto Arsizio]], [[Italy]]. [https://www.ilfattoquotidiano.it/2020/09/04/legionella-a-busto-arsizio-16-casi-accertati-e-un-morto-in-corso-esami-sullacqua/5920926/ (''Il Fatto Quotidiano'')]

;International relations
*[[2020 Kosovo–Serbia agreement]], [[Kosovo–Serbia relations]]
**[[Kosovo]] and [[Serbia]] announce that they will normalize economic relations. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/europe/kosovo-serbia-normalize-economic-ties-improve-israel-relationship-in-us-brokered-talks (''Daily Sabah'')]
*[[Israel–Kosovo relations]], [[Israel–Serbia relations]]
**[[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli Prime Minister]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]] announces that Kosovo and Serbia will open their embassies in disputed [[Jerusalem]], recognizing the city as [[Israel]]'s capital. Netanyahu says Kosovo is the first Muslim-majority country to do so. Until this day, only the [[United States]] and [[Guatemala]] have moved their embassies to Jerusalem, a move that Palestinians reject. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-serbia-kosovo-usa-jerusalem/serbia-kosovo-to-open-israel-embassies-in-jerusalem-idUSKBN25V2GF (Reuters)]
*[[Nuclear program of Iran]]
**The [[International Atomic Energy Agency]] reports that [[Iran]] has stockpiled {{convert|2,105|kg|lb}} of [[enriched uranium]], violating the {{convert|300|kg|lb}} limit under the [[Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/iran-uranium-stockpile-10-times-limit-set-in-nuclear-deal/a-54821705 (DW)]
*[[China–Malaysia relations]]
**[[Malaysia]]n Minister in the Prime Minister's Department [[Mohd Redzuan Md Yusof]] announces that [[Uyghurs|Uyghur]] refugees in the country will not be extradited back to [[China]], but permitted to use Malaysia as a safe passage to a third country. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-malaysia-china-uighur/malaysia-wont-extradite-uighurs-to-china-minister-says-idUSKBN25V1KE?utm_source=reddit.com (Reuters)]
*[[Palau–United States relations]]
**It is revealed that [[Palau]] urged the [[United States]] to build joint-use military facilities in the country, a move seen as a push back against Chinese influence in the Pacific. Palauan President [[Tommy Remengesau Jr.]] made the request in a letter to [[U.S. Secretary of Defense]] [[Mark Esper]], who visited the island country last week. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/world/palau-pacific-united-states-military-china-influence-13081206 (CNA)] [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/425291/palau-invites-us-military-to-use-land-and-waters (RNZ)]
*[[2020 Belarusian protests]], [[Foreign relations of Belarus]]
**[[Belarus]] opposition leader [[Sviatlana Tsikhanouskaya]] calls for the [[United Nations Security Council]] to stop [[Human rights in Belarus|human rights abuse in her country]]. [https://www.voanews.com/europe/belarus-opposition-leader-appeals-un-stop-human-rights-abuses-her-country (VOANews)]

;Law and crime
*[[Football Leaks]]
**Rui Pinto begins his trial at the Central Criminal Procedure Court in [[Lisbon]], [[Portugal]], on charges of attempted qualified extortion, violation of [[secrecy]], and illegally accessing information for leaking financial transactions within European [[association football]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/09/trial-opens-accused-football-leaks-mastermind-200904153518688.html (Al Jazeera)]
*''[[United States v. Guzmán]]''
**Mexican [[drug lord]] [[Joaquín "El Chapo" Guzmán]] appeals to the [[United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit]] against his [[Life imprisonment in the United States|life imprisonment]] sentence handed down by the [[U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of New York]] in July 2019. Guzmán's lawyer claims that his maximum-security isolation at the [[Metropolitan Correctional Center, New York|Metropolitan Correctional Center]] following his extradition to the United States in January 2017 made him heavily unaware about his case and limited his ability to participate in his defense. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/convicted-mexican-drug-lord-el-chapo-appeals-against-life-sentence-2290811 (AFP via NDTV)]
*[[Killing of Daniel Prude]]
**Protests over a fatal police encounter in [[Rochester, New York]] began peacefully but ended with authorities using tear gas and pepper balls following incidents of vandalism and violence. It was the third straight night of protests after video was released earlier in the week showing [[Rochester Police Department]] officers holding Daniel Prude on the ground with a spit sock on his head in March. Prude stopped breathing and was declared brain dead at a hospital. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/09/05/us/rochester-protests-daniel-prude-death/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[George Floyd protests in Portland, Oregon]]
**American [[social media]] service [[Facebook]] deletes pages associated with the [[Portland, Oregon]]-based [[Far right politics|far-right]] group [[Patriot Prayer]] and its founder, [[Joey Gibson (political activist)|Joey Gibson]], citing efforts to remove "violent social [[militia]]s" from its [[Facebook Platform|platform]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/technology/2020/sep/05/facebook-removes-patriot-prayer-pages-in-bid-to-halt-violent-social-militias (''The Guardian'')]
*Former [[Prime Minister of Australia]] [[Tony Abbott]] is appointed as an adviser to the [[United Kingdom]]'s [[Board of Trade]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-britain-eu-abbott/britain-names-former-australian-pm-abbott-as-trade-adviser-idUSKBN25V2F2 (Reuters)]

;Sports
*[[2020 Diamond League]]
**British long-distance runner [[Mo Farah]] and Dutch long-distance runner [[Sifan Hassan]] break the world record for [[One hour run|most distance covered in one hour]] for men and women respectively, by running {{convert|21.330|km|miles}} and  {{convert|18.930|km|miles}} during the [[Brussels]] meet. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/athletics/54031824 (BBC Sport)]
